# Malformed DNS packets; src/wire.zig must reject every one (ADR 0011). One packet per line,
# `name = hex`; a `#` starts a comment. Regenerate by hand: each line documents one check.
# empty packet
empty = 
# header cut short
short-header = 00000100000100000000
# qdcount says one question, none follows
missing-question = 000001000001000000000000
# qdcount says two questions, one follows
qdcount-too-high = 000001000002000000000000076578616d706c65036f72670000010001
# ancount says one RR, none follows
missing-rr = 000081800001000100000000076578616d706c65036f72670000010001
# a byte after the last section
trailing-garbage = 000001000001000000000000076578616d706c65036f7267000001000100
# question cut inside a label
truncated-label = 000001000001000000000000076578616d
# question cut before the class
truncated-question = 000001000001000000000000076578616d706c65036f7267000001
# the first label of the name is a pointer to itself
pointer-self = 000001000001000000000000c00c00010001
# pointer to a later offset
pointer-forward = 000001000001000000000000c00e076578616d706c65036f72670000010001
# pointer to offset 0 where the id bytes 0xffff read as another pointer past the end
pointer-into-header = ffff01000001000000000000c00000010001
# pointer whose second byte is missing
pointer-cut = 000001000001000000000000c0
# extended label type 0x40 (RFC 6891 deprecated them)
label-type-0x40 = 000001000001000000000000410000010001
# extended label type 0x80 (unassigned)
label-type-0x80 = 000001000001000000000000810000010001
# five 63-byte labels: 320 bytes, limit is 255
name-too-long = 
# owner is 64 bytes plus a pointer to a 193-byte name: 257 bytes once expanded
compressed-name-too-long = 
# rdlength 0xffff on a 4-byte packet tail
rdlength-past-end = 000081800001000100000000076578616d706c65036f72670000010001c00c0001000100000000ffff01020304
# SOA rdata of 5 bytes
soa-rdata-short = 000081800001000100000000076578616d706c65036f72670000010001c00c0006000100000e1000050102030405
# MX rdata with the preference and no exchange name
mx-rdata-no-name = 000081800001000100000000076578616d706c65036f72670000010001c00c000f000100000e100002000a
# SRV rdata with the target cut after its first label
srv-rdata-cut = 000081800001000100000000076578616d706c65036f72670000010001c00c0021000100000e10000b0000000000350373697003
# CNAME rdata with a byte after the name
cname-rdata-trailing = 000081800001000100000000076578616d706c65036f72670000010001c00c0005000100000e100003c00c00
# CNAME rdata whose name points forward to itself
cname-rdata-pointer-self = 000081800001000100000000076578616d706c65036f72670000010001c00c0005000100000e100002c029
# NS rdata empty in class IN (empty RDATA is only a class ANY delete, RFC 2136)
ns-rdata-empty = 000081800001000100000000076578616d706c65036f72670000010001c00c0002000100000e100000
# header counts promise 65535 RRs on a 12-byte packet
counts-lie = 000001000000ffff00000000
# review A1: 166 questions, each a pointer to the previous one (valid compression, quadratic
# pointer walking): rejected once the per-packet hop budget (one per byte) runs out
pointer-chain-questions =
